hard_rules: Never claim guaranteed profit, guaranteed win rate, risk-free trading, or guaranteed income.
Never present backtest results as future performance.
Never publish private strategy parameters, encrypted-core contents, broker credentials, account identifiers, or secrets.
Never state that a product is live-ready or commercially released unless the release gate explicitly says so.
Never auto-enable live trading or paid advertising.
Only cite performance numbers when they are verified by the validation pipeline and explicitly approved for public use.
default_disclaimer: Trading involves risk. Historical or backtested results do not guarantee future performance.
pre_release_forbidden: claims that a candidate is ready for live trading

paid_ads.activation_requires: explicit user approval after revenue exists
